native.statistics_scope: Valid holdouts only; incomplete groups cannot establish comparison

spatial.statistics_scope: Valid holdouts only; incomplete groups cannot establish comparison

ketris.statistics_scope: Valid holdouts only; incomplete groups cannot establish comparison

native_vs_ketris.index_formula: 100 * mean(baseline actual makespan) / mean(KETRIS actual makespan)
native_vs_ketris.time_reduction_formula: 100 * (1 - mean(KETRIS actual makespan) / mean(baseline actual makespan))

spatial_vs_ketris.index_formula: 100 * mean(baseline actual makespan) / mean(KETRIS actual makespan)
spatial_vs_ketris.time_reduction_formula: 100 * (1 - mean(KETRIS actual makespan) / mean(baseline actual makespan))

definitions.makespan: max(request completion_ns across all seven workers) - go.start_ns
definitions.std: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1); zero for n=1
definitions.pilots: Excluded from all primary aggregates; retained and audited
definitions.failure_handling: Every run retained; any invalid or missing holdout blocks its arm comparisons
definitions.device_busy: Secondary NVML activity gauge over covered intervals; not useful-work efficiency
